blocks.h: Questions engineers and quality control ask

items.q: We had a plastic loop fail before. What is different?
items.a: Joints and supports. Each joint is made by a qualified welder and logged; supports follow the pipe maker's published data. Tell us what failed in yours; we check our design against it.

items.q: How do you keep flow turbulent when several outlets open?
items.a: We size pipe and pump for the worst-case outlet combination, not the average. At the site acceptance test (SAT), we open those outlets together and record return flow.

items.q: Can we add points of use later?
items.a: Yes, after a hydraulic check at the new peak demand. Each branch is cut in with the point-of-use valve named in your proposal, under your change control. Shutdown: planned with you.

items.q: How do you show the sanitant reached every outlet?
items.a: The sanitization procedure names every outlet opened in the cycle. Each outlet is then flushed and the residual tested before use.
